pages.name: Bird: From Gambit, Lasker, Queenswap Line
pages.notes: Plans had Kc2 and Bg2 for White without the forced 8.Kxd1 (and Bg2 needs g3 first). Rewritten around the queenless middlegame: ...Nc6 against e5, long castling with check, Bf4.

pages.name: Bird's Opening, 1...e6
pages.notes: Plan had Ne5 in a Stonewall without Nf3; American spelling. Rewritten, adding the 2.e4 d5 French transposition.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Dutch Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 named an e8-a4 diagonal against White's king (it is Black's own); overview in American spelling. Overview and plans 3-4 rewritten.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Sturm Gambit
pages.notes: Plans had Bxc4 without ...dxc4 and a semi-open f-file with the f4-pawn on it. Rewritten around 3.e3/4.Bxc4 and 3.Qa4+/4.Qxc4.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Thomas Gambit
pages.notes: needs-research: plan 1 has Re1, impossible before castling, but the gambit's real follow-up after 5...dxe3 was not settled by the board or a short search. Text left unchanged; Re1 added to the skips.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Williams Gambit
pages.notes: Plans had White using an open f-file (the f4-pawn is on it) and Black solidifying a d5-pawn that is on e4. Rewritten around Qe2, g4 and d3 against Black's ...Nf6 and ...Bf5.

pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.b3
pages.notes: Overview called the c1-bishop light-squared; plans had O-O without development and vague attacking ideas. Rewritten around Bb2 and e5, ...c5 and the 3...d4 option.

pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.Nf3 g6 3.e3
pages.notes: Plan had Qe1-h4 with the king on e1 and a b8-knight route to c7. Rewritten as a Stonewall versus fianchetto with ...Bf5 to trade the d3-bishop.

pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plans had ...Bg7 neutralising the g2-bishop (different diagonal) and a knight route d2-f1-e3 through the d2-pawn and the f1-bishop. Rewritten around the e4 break.

pages.name: Bird: 1...d5 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plan had the f3-knight going to e1 with the king there, and plans without side prefixes. Rewritten around d3/e4, c4 and Black's ...c5, ...e5 and ...c6.
